rationale: Evidence vote is not_defect (rowCount=0 for unflushed data is by-design stats-lag per issue 50193, no flush ever issued), so severity sits at the trivial floor; even hypothetically, a Type4-ish stats-consistency base of High would be demoted by metadata-plane get_stats (-1), DOC_PARTIAL (-1), and single-script trigger (-1) down to trivial, with no crash signals to force Critical.
